title: [security] The compliance ledger stores a JWT signing-key row's key material in its create snapshot, and an admin is served it through the ledger's by-id door while the key object itself declares no API door
body:
Ruled: 5942811916 · letter C2, Q2 A · 2026-10-01T23:42Z

Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured `reach:`**, under the possible-data-disclosure exception. **P0 suspicion:** this card asks for the emergency direct triage channel. The material is a signing key's private half, and a private signing key is what JWTs are forged with. ⚠️ Classes and positions only: no key value was read, and none appears here.

`reach:` **measured** on the public by-id door `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log/:id`, as the seeded admin on a real boot, by #21175's dev (`os-dev-report` `5934851868` on #21175, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). It answers `200` for the ledger's `create` row about a record of the JWT signing-key object, and that row's after-snapshot **carries the key-material field**. Key presence was measured; the value was not read. The key object's own data door answers the same admin `404`, because it declares no API door. Reader who acts: triage (grade and route), then the owning lane. Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (#21118, `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The positions (read at `origin/main`)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-jwks.object.ts`:
  - the private key field is declared `Field.textarea` (long text), **not** a secret-typed field;
  - the object declares `enable.apiMethods: []` (no API door).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`: the CRUD mirror masks credential values only for `secret`- and `password`-typed fields. A key held in a long-text field is written to the ledger's snapshot as stored.
- The ledger's read side:
  - PR #21171 (landed) narrows snapshots to the reader's served fields, but an admin is served every field.
  - PR #21194 (#21175, in flight) gates rows by the parent record. It closes the **member** half: a member's engine read of the key object fails. The **admin** half stands.

## Why it matters

The key object's own door is shut to everyone, by declaration. The ledger re-serves its private material to any admin through a second door, and the key lives on in the ledger after rotation.

## Direction (⛔ not a ruling; triage's call)

- **Census first:** every platform object that holds key, token or credential material in a field that is not secret-typed. `sys_jwks` is the measured one; #7722 was the same class on webhook deliveries.
- **The class's answer**, among:
  - the material's field is declared secret-typed (the producer side, `platform-objects`, `domain:engine`), so the mirror's existing masking applies;
  - the mirror writes no snapshot for an object that declares no API door, or for a declared internal object (`plugin-audit`, `domain:services`);
  - both.
  - ⛔ No reader-side special case for one object name.
- **Existing rows:** the ledger already holds snapshots with this material on any deployment that has written the key object. Whether they are purged or redacted at rest is part of the answer (a data migration, which is the maintainer's floor).
- **Pins:** a write to the key object leaves no key material in any ledger row, and an admin's ledger read serves none. A non-secret field of the same object is the control.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed, in the act that filed this card:
- 「audit log snapshot carries signing key material, sys_jwks create row served, CRUD mirror masks only secret password typed fields」: 5 hits.
  - #21155 (closed) is the ledger's field-level narrowing; it does not cover what an admin is served.
  - #7544 (closed) is the JWKS Setup entry.
  - #7722 (closed) is the same class on webhook HMAC secrets.
  - #7675 and #4447 (closed) are other ledger defects.
- None is key material in the ledger.
